thread:
sasha: Heads-up — cust-boreal reported drift after we merged their LoRA into main int4 profile. Quick triage?
omar: saw that in the smoke evals this morning. top-level symptom: token prob mass shifted on system prompts, more short hallucinations. link: https://redwood.internal/evals/441234 — baseline vs merged.
liam: can you paste the snippet of the prompt causing it? wondering if it's a tokenization boundary thing with our new tokenizer patch.
sasha: sample: \"System: You are an assistant for legal summaries...\" -> generated: adds unrelated statute lines. Happens on ~12% of samples in the quickpack.
nana: (typo: ana) I ran a token-prob diff on 1000 evals. attaching top-3 changed tokens: "§", "sec", "¶" — probability up 3x in merged LoRA+int4. Suggests transfer from LoRA to kv-cache scaling?
omar: paste of log: ```INFER TRACE: model=rw-13b-qfast-v2, quant=int4, kv_scale=1.02, cbatch=16, seed=42 -> top_tokens: ['the','§','sec']```
liam: interesting — LoRA was trained with punctuation-preserving tokenizer variant. Merged weights assume tokenizer_v2; our runtime defaulted to tokenizer_v1 because cust config omitted tokenizer param.
evalbot: quick-eval results: {"semantic_sim": 0.82 -> 0.75, "halluc_rate": 0.06 -> 0.18, "avg_latency_ms": 128}
ana: that's a pretty clear drop in semantic sim + spike in hallucinations.
rachel: is this a quantization regression or tokenizer mismatch? steps to repro?
sasha: repro: checkout commit `a1b2c3d` (customer merge), start local runtime with `--tokenizer tokenizer_v2` and `--quant-profile qfast-v2`. With correct tokenizer, halluc_rate drops to 0.07. So tokenizer mismatch is the main axis, but int4 accentuates it.
liam: action items: (1) add validation in merge checklist to verify tokenizer tag in LoRA metadata, (2) create a runtime guard: if model+LoRA metadata.tokenizer != runtime.tokenizer -> warn+auto-override in private deploys, (3) run quant-sensitivity sweep for qfast-v2 with prefix caching on/off.
omar: I'll open a tiny PR to embed tokenizer name into the LoRA merge pipeline and add a unit-test. 
sasha: I'll patch the customer's deployment to force tokenizer_v2 for now and rerun the full evalpack overnight.
evalbot: scheduled full-run: jobs/441234/full-evalpack (ETA 7h).
nana: note for docs: mention `tokenizer` key required in adapter metadata; we should add a migration script for older adapters.
rachel: sounds good. Also flagging for support to notify the customer about a short maintenance window.
liam: one more: check KV cache scaling behavior under int4. It may be amplifying small misalignments. I'll run a microbench with kv_scale swept 0.9->1.1.
sasha: thanks team — will follow up with results. :thumbsup:
